method.temperature_truth: nearest sufficiently fresh DWD hourly air-temperature observation; not a sensor in Nové Hraběcí
method.rain_truth_priority: qualitative RainViewer signal within 7 km of NH when archived; otherwise nearest fresh DWD hourly rain observation
method.note: Radar is used only for rain/no-rain verification, not as gauge millimetres. Model weights are not changed automatically.
